name: Smash Submit
description: Gamified submit button where repeated clicks make a tiny stick figure lift a barbell. Reaching the top swaps the label to a success message and bursts confetti.
contents: Button with a stick figure lifter and barbell icon
behavior: Each click pumps progress; progress decays when idle
Figure limbs and barbell interpolate through keyframes as progress rises
At full progress the label swaps, confetti bursts, then the button resets after 2 seconds
Click ripple expands from the pointer position
editableByProps: Button, hover, text and shadow colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change button size or corner radius

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Reset delay after completion is 2 seconds
